ore_copper.name: Copper Ore
ore_copper.lore: Green-veined stone from the grave soil.

ore_tin.name: Tin Ore
ore_tin.lore: Dull ore, cold as a burial ring.

ore_silver.name: Silver Ore
ore_silver.lore: Corpse-silver; it tarnishes near the living.

log_elm.name: Elm Log
log_elm.lore: Cut from a hangman's elm. The rope scars run deep.

log_willow.name: Willow Log
log_willow.lore: The sap runs red and never quite dries.

log_yew.name: Yew Log
log_yew.lore: Churchyard yew: the roots drink from the graves.

log_ghostwood.name: Ghostwood Log
log_ghostwood.lore: Pale, cold and lighter than it should be.

log_bone_elder.name: Bone Elder Log
log_bone_elder.lore: It knocks like bone when you stack it.

fish_crypt_eel.name: Crypt Eel
fish_crypt_eel.lore: Slid out of a flooded vault.

fish_bell_carp.name: Bell Carp
fish_bell_carp.lore: Its scales ring faintly when tapped.

fish_lanternfish.name: Lanternfish
fish_lanternfish.lore: Still glowing, even out of the water.

fish_coelacanth.name: Abyssal Coelacanth
fish_coelacanth.lore: Older than the Covenant, and it looks it.

bones_old.name: Old Bones
bones_old.lore: A pauper's remains. Grind them for the garden.

bones_barrow.name: Barrow Bones
bones_barrow.lore: Heavy bones from a burial mound.

bones_ancient.name: Ancient Bones
bones_ancient.lore: A barrow-king's bones, crowned with lichen.

seed_mourning_moss.name: Mourning Moss Seed
seed_mourning_moss.lore: Plant it in a mourning bed.

reliquary_fragment.name: Reliquary Fragment
reliquary_fragment.lore: Gilded shards from a broken reliquary.

covenant_seal.name: Covenant Seal
covenant_seal.lore: The wax still bears the Ossuary mark.

flask_void_resist.name: Void Resist Flask
flask_void_resist.lore: Wards off 25% of all damage for 90 seconds.

ring_copper.name: Copper Ring
ring_copper.lore: A mourning band. The name inside is scratched out.

staff_oak.name: Oak Staff
staff_oak.lore: A coffin-oak focus. Bone Needles fly truer.

chest_iron.name: Iron Chestplate
chest_iron.lore: Salt-bloomed plate from a crypt knight.

seed_nightshade.name: Nightshade Seed
seed_nightshade.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed.

herb_corpse_lily.name: Corpse-lily
herb_corpse_lily.lore: It flowers only on fresh graves.

seed_corpse_lily.name: Corpse-lily Seed
seed_corpse_lily.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed.

herb_wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
herb_wolfsbane.lore: Older than the wolves that fear it.

seed_wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane Seed
seed_wolfsbane.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed.

herb_bloodroot.name: Bloodroot
herb_bloodroot.lore: The soil around it is always warm.

seed_bloodroot.name: Bloodroot Seed
seed_bloodroot.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed.

herb_moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
herb_moonpetal.lore: It opens for the dead alone.

seed_moonpetal.name: Moonpetal Seed
seed_moonpetal.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed.

sapling_oak.name: Coffin-Oak Sapling
sapling_oak.lore: Plant it in a Coffin Patch and come back in a couple of hours.

sapling_yew.name: Churchyard Yew Sapling
sapling_yew.lore: Slow, patient and worth the wait.

charm_tithe_bat.name: Tithe Bat Charm
charm_tithe_bat.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Tithe Bat is yours for good. It roosts in the coffin-oaks and follows the sound of the axe.

charm_grave_rat.name: Grave Rat Charm
charm_grave_rat.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Grave Rat is yours for good. It found a better seam than you did, and it will not tell you where.

charm_drowned_pup.name: Drowned Pup Charm
charm_drowned_pup.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Drowned Pup is yours for good. Pulled from black water, still wet, still hopeful.

charm_wee_thrall.name: Wee Thrall Charm
charm_wee_thrall.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Wee Thrall is yours for good. A very small skeleton with a very large sense of duty.

charm_shroud_moth.name: Shroud Moth Charm
charm_shroud_moth.lore: Adopt it (Capes & Pets, N) and the Shroud Moth is yours for good. It drinks the light from the beds and gives a little back.

flask_hp_grand.name: Grand Healing Flask
flask_hp_grand.lore: Bloodroot and corpse-lily, brewed until the glass runs warm. Restores 90% health. Press Q.

elixir_moonlight.name: Moonlight Elixir
elixir_moonlight.lore: +25% spell damage for 60 seconds. It glows faintly, and the dead lean toward it.

reagent_grave_dust.name: Grave Dust
reagent_grave_dust.lore: Sifted from what the dead leave behind. Take it to the Great Cauldron in the Alchemist's Wing: four dust brew a Grave-Dust Tonic, no garden needed.

reagent_wraith_ectoplasm.name: Wraith Ectoplasm
reagent_wraith_ectoplasm.lore: Cold, weightless and faintly singing. Choir Wraiths and Weeping Seraphs shed it when they unravel. Brews into haste and insight.

reagent_plague_bile.name: Plague Bile
reagent_plague_bile.lore: Bottled from the Cloister dead, still green and still spoiling. The base of the lifesteal and rot-proof brews.

reagent_cinder_ash.name: Cinder Ash
reagent_cinder_ash.lore: Grey ash with a red heart that never cools. Falls from the Pyre; brews into fire-proofing.

herb_rot_cap.name: Rot-cap
herb_rot_cap.lore: A pale mushroom that grows out of the Cloister flagstones. Forage it there, or plant its seed in the Acre (Gardening 35).

seed_rot_cap.name: Rot-cap Seed
seed_rot_cap.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed (Grave Gardening 35). Foraged in the Plague Cloister.

herb_ash_bloom.name: Ash-bloom
herb_ash_bloom.lore: A black flower that only opens in cinders. Forage it in the Pyre, or plant its seed in the Acre (Gardening 50).

seed_ash_bloom.name: Ash-bloom Seed
seed_ash_bloom.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed (Grave Gardening 50). Foraged in the Cinder Pyre.

ichor_gravedigger.name: Gravedigger Ichor
ichor_gravedigger.lore: The Gravedigger King's blood, black as churned earth. Guaranteed from his spoils; top-tier elixirs need it.

ichor_abbess.name: Abbess Ichor
ichor_abbess.lore: Marrow-pale and never quite still. Guaranteed from the Bone Abbess; top-tier elixirs need it.

ichor_congregation.name: Congregation Ichor
ichor_congregation.lore: Drowned-blue, and it hums a hymn. Guaranteed from the Drowned Congregation; top-tier elixirs need it.

ichor_prelate.name: Prelate Ichor
ichor_prelate.lore: Bell-bronze and heavy. Guaranteed from the Bell-Sworn Prelate; top-tier elixirs need it.

ichor_plague_saint.name: Plague Saint Ichor
ichor_plague_saint.lore: The Saint's own blight, sweet and green. Guaranteed from the Plague Saint; top-tier elixirs need it.

ichor_regent.name: Regent Ichor
ichor_regent.lore: Liquid ember that does not burn the glass. Guaranteed from the Cinder Regent; top-tier elixirs need it.

tonic_grave_dust.name: Grave-Dust Tonic
tonic_grave_dust.lore: Tonic. +20% essence regeneration for 60 seconds. Four pinches of grave dust in black water: the first brew anyone can make from what the dead drop.

elixir_wraithquick.name: Wraithquick Elixir
elixir_wraithquick.lore: Elixir. +15% cooldown recovery for 45 seconds. Ectoplasm sings in the glass, and your rites come back quicker for it.

tonic_graveluck.name: Grave-Luck Tonic
tonic_graveluck.lore: Tonic. +15% item drop chance for 60 seconds. Nightshade and a fistful of grave dust: the dead hold on to their things a little less tightly.

tonic_insight.name: Sexton's Insight
tonic_insight.lore: Tonic. +15% experience from kills for 60 seconds. Ectoplasm and mourning moss steeped together; every death teaches a little more.

elixir_leechblood.name: Leechblood Elixir
elixir_leechblood.lore: Elixir. Heal 4% of the damage you deal for 45 seconds (up to three targets per hit, at most 1.5% of your health per hit). Plague bile that remembers being alive.

elixir_rotproof.name: Rot-Proof Elixir
elixir_rotproof.lore: Elixir. 40% less rot and plague damage for 75 seconds (adds to other wards; the total caps at 60%). Bile and rot-cap, taken before the Plague Saint.

elixir_cinderskin.name: Cinderskin Elixir
elixir_cinderskin.lore: Elixir. 40% less fire damage for 75 seconds (adds to other wards; the total caps at 60%). Cinder ash and ash-bloom: walk the Pyre as if it were a hearth.

tonic_ghostwalk.name: Ghostwalk Tonic
tonic_ghostwalk.lore: Tonic. +30% essence regeneration and +10% move speed for 75 seconds. Ectoplasm and wolfsbane: you drift more than you walk.

elixir_bloodmoon.name: Bloodmoon Elixir
elixir_bloodmoon.lore: Elixir. +20% spell damage and heal 6% of the damage you deal for 60 seconds. Two kings' ichor and plague bile, drunk under a red moon.

elixir_hymnal.name: Hymnal Elixir
elixir_hymnal.lore: Elixir. 15% less damage taken, 20% less rot and plague damage, and heal 3% of the damage you deal, for 75 seconds. The drowned hymn and the Saint's blight, made to cancel each other out.

elixir_regent.name: Regent's Vigil Elixir
elixir_regent.lore: Elixir. +12% spell damage, 15% less damage taken and +10% cooldown recovery for 60 seconds. The Regent's ichor and the Prelate's, bound with cinder ash: the last word in elixirs.

herb_bog_myrtle.name: Bog Myrtle
herb_bog_myrtle.lore: Waxy grey leaves dug from the peat. Its smoke keeps the marsh-fever off the living.

herb_drowned_lotus.name: Drowned Lotus
herb_drowned_lotus.lore: It blooms under black water and glows faintly, as if lit from below.

seed_bog_myrtle.name: Bog Myrtle Seed
seed_bog_myrtle.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed. It grows best in damp, dark ground.

seed_drowned_lotus.name: Drowned Lotus Seed
seed_drowned_lotus.lore: Plant it in a Mourning Bed and keep it patient.

ichor_mire.name: Mire Ichor
ichor_mire.lore: The Mire Mother leaves this dark, silver-flecked ichor. Brew it with drowned lotus for Moonlight Elixir.

plank_yew.name: Yew Plank
plank_yew.lore: Churchyard yew: springy, and it remembers.

plank_ghostwood.name: Ghostwood Plank
plank_ghostwood.lore: Pale, cold, and lighter than air should allow.

plank_bone_elder.name: Bone Elder Plank
plank_bone_elder.lore: It clacks like bone when you stack it.

meal_crypt_eel.name: Smoked Crypt Eel
meal_crypt_eel.lore: Smoked over coffin-wood. Heals over time.

meal_bell_carp.name: Bell Carp Stew
meal_bell_carp.lore: It still rings faintly in the bowl. Heals over time.

meal_drowned_pike.name: Drowned Pike Fillet
meal_drowned_pike.lore: All teeth removed. Most of them. Heals over time.

meal_lanternfish.name: Lanternfish Supper
meal_lanternfish.lore: It glows on the plate. Heals over time.

meal_coelacanth.name: Coelacanth Feast
meal_coelacanth.lore: Older than the Covenant, and filling. Heals over time.

bone_meal.name: Bone Meal
bone_meal.lore: Ground at the Bone Kiln. Mourning beds love it.

leg_legion_unburied_head.name: Warcrown of the Unburied
leg_legion_unburied_head.lore: Forged for the one who never lets the dead lie. The legion marches in its wearer’s footsteps, and does not stop.

leg_colossus_mantle_head.name: Colossus Cowl
leg_colossus_mantle_head.lore: A giant’s ribs, hung with every vow the Covenant ever broke. What strikes the wearer is struck back.

leg_colossus_mantle_chest.name: Colossus Mantle
leg_colossus_mantle_chest.lore: A giant’s ribs, hung with every vow the Covenant ever broke. What strikes the wearer is struck back.

leg_requiem_wraiths_head.name: Wraithveil Hood
leg_requiem_wraiths_head.lore: Woven from the last breath of the mourned. The wraiths still sing in it, and some of them stay to help.

leg_requiem_wraiths_chest.name: Requiem Shroud
leg_requiem_wraiths_chest.lore: Woven from the last breath of the mourned. The wraiths still sing in it, and some of them stay to help.

leg_requiem_wraiths_hands.lore: Woven from the last breath of the mourned. The wraiths still sing in it, and some of them stay to help.

leg_requiem_wraiths_legs.lore: Woven from the last breath of the mourned. The wraiths still sing in it, and some of them stay to help.

leg_requiem_wraiths_feet.name: Requiem Slippers
leg_requiem_wraiths_feet.lore: Woven from the last breath of the mourned. The wraiths still sing in it, and some of them stay to help.

leg_plague_choir_head.name: Choirmaster’s Mask
leg_plague_choir_head.lore: Sung into being by a congregation that died of its own hymn. Every note it carries is catching.

leg_plague_choir_chest.name: Plague Choir Surplice
leg_plague_choir_chest.lore: Sung into being by a congregation that died of its own hymn. Every note it carries is catching.

leg_plague_choir_hands.name: Blightmonger’s Gloves
leg_plague_choir_hands.lore: Sung into being by a congregation that died of its own hymn. Every note it carries is catching.

leg_plague_choir_legs.name: Choir Rotleggings
leg_plague_choir_legs.lore: Sung into being by a congregation that died of its own hymn. Every note it carries is catching.

leg_plague_choir_feet.name: Plague Choir Treads
leg_plague_choir_feet.lore: Sung into being by a congregation that died of its own hymn. Every note it carries is catching.

staff_bone.name: Vertebral Staff
staff_bone.lore: Fused vertebrae, still warm from the hand that carried it. Bone Needles fly farther and pierce a second body.

staff_iron.name: Crypt-Iron Crozier
staff_iron.lore: A grave-watch crozier with a bell-metal cap. Bone Needles fly farther and pierce a second body.

staff_gold.name: Reliquary Staff
staff_gold.lore: Tithe-gold wound round a reliquary shaft. Bone Needles fly farther and pierce a second body.

staff_hell.name: Hellcoal Crozier
staff_hell.lore: Quenched in pyre-coal; the skull at its head never stops smoking. Bone Needles fly farther and pierce a second body.

staff_moon.name: Staff of the Pale Moon
staff_moon.lore: Cut from a bone that never touched the ground. Bone Needles fly farther and pierce a second body.

scythe_bone.name: Gleaner's Scythe
scythe_bone.lore: A gleaner cuts what the living left standing. Your left click becomes a reaping arc; kills in it yield a soul.

scythe_iron.name: Sexton's Scythe
scythe_iron.lore: The sexton swings it at dusk, in rows. Your left click becomes a reaping arc; kills in it yield a soul.

scythe_gold.name: Tithe-Reaper
scythe_gold.lore: Every swing tolls a coin against the dead. Your left click becomes a reaping arc; kills in it yield a soul.

scythe_hell.name: Pyre Reaper
scythe_hell.lore: Its edge glows where it has drunk ash. Your left click becomes a reaping arc; kills in it yield a soul.

scythe_moon.name: Moonreaper
scythe_moon.lore: The last harvest is always by moonlight. Your left click becomes a reaping arc; kills in it yield a soul.

wand_bone.name: Knucklebone Wand
wand_bone.lore: Finger bones, bound in a hurry. Bone Needles come faster and strike softer.

wand_iron.name: Iron Mourning Wand
wand_iron.lore: A mourner flicks it like a hand-bell. Bone Needles come faster and strike softer.

wand_gold.name: Gilded Censer Wand
wand_gold.lore: A censer chain wound round the grip. Bone Needles come faster and strike softer.

wand_hell.name: Emberthorn Wand
wand_hell.lore: Thorned, and warm to the touch. Bone Needles come faster and strike softer.

wand_moon.name: Wand of Quiet Stars
wand_moon.lore: It weighs nothing, and is never quite still. Bone Needles come faster and strike softer.

sickle_bone.name: Barrow Sickle
sickle_bone.lore: A curved rib, sharpened on a headstone. Bone Needles leave the target Withered; Exhume returns essence.

sickle_iron.name: Plague Sickle
sickle_iron.lore: The plague priests cut herbs and throats with it. Bone Needles leave the target Withered; Exhume returns essence.

sickle_gold.name: Sexton's Gilded Sickle
sickle_gold.lore: Gilded for rites nobody admits to. Bone Needles leave the target Withered; Exhume returns essence.

sickle_hell.name: Blightfire Sickle
sickle_hell.lore: The rot burns instead of festering. Bone Needles leave the target Withered; Exhume returns essence.

sickle_moon.name: Moonrot Sickle
sickle_moon.lore: Its blade is etched with a blight the moon forgave. Bone Needles leave the target Withered; Exhume returns essence.

skull_focus_bone.name: Pauper's Skull Focus
skull_focus_bone.lore: A nameless skull that still listens. (Gold and better skulls hold one more thrall.)

skull_focus_iron.name: Iron-Jawed Skull Focus
skull_focus_iron.lore: Its jaw is wired shut so it cannot argue. (Gold and better skulls hold one more thrall.)

skull_focus_gold.name: Gilded Skull Focus
skull_focus_gold.lore: It remembers a legion. Hold it and command one more thrall.

skull_focus_hell.name: Cinder Skull Focus
skull_focus_hell.lore: The eyes glow like coals in a cold hearth. Hold it and command one more thrall.

skull_focus_moon.name: Moon Skull Focus
skull_focus_moon.lore: It was a king, once; it still expects to be obeyed. Hold it and command one more thrall.

grimoire_bone.name: Gravedigger's Grimoire
grimoire_bone.lore: A gravedigger's ledger of names and their uses. Rites recover sooner.

grimoire_iron.name: Iron-Clasped Grimoire
grimoire_iron.lore: Chained shut, and opened only from the inside. Rites recover sooner.

grimoire_gold.name: Gilt Reliquary Grimoire
grimoire_gold.lore: Every page is gilt, every margin a warning. Rites recover sooner.

grimoire_hell.name: Hellbound Grimoire
grimoire_hell.lore: Its binding is singed along the spine. Rites recover sooner.

grimoire_moon.name: Moonlit Grimoire
grimoire_moon.lore: The pages turn themselves to the rite you need. Rites recover sooner.

mourning_bell_bone.name: Pauper's Mourning Bell
mourning_bell_bone.lore: Rung once for each name you could not save. A Mourner's wraith hits mend allies.

mourning_bell_iron.name: Iron Mourning Bell
mourning_bell_iron.lore: Its note is flat on purpose. A Mourner's wraith hits mend allies.

mourning_bell_gold.name: Gilded Mourning Bell
mourning_bell_gold.lore: The clapper is wrapped in widow's silk. A Mourner's wraith hits mend allies.

mourning_bell_hell.name: Cinder Mourning Bell
mourning_bell_hell.lore: It tolls for the ones who should have stayed buried. A Mourner's wraith hits mend allies.

mourning_bell_moon.name: Moon Mourning Bell
mourning_bell_moon.lore: You hear it a moment before it rings. A Mourner's wraith hits mend allies.

rune_splinter.name: Rune of Splinters
rune_splinter.lore: The needle shatters on bone and the shards keep looking.

rune_ossuary_ring.name: Ossuary Ring Rune
rune_ossuary_ring.lore: The dead rise in a circle, like a congregation.

rune_mass_grave.name: Mass Grave Rune
rune_mass_grave.lore: Why dig one grave when the field is full?

rune_bone_colossus.name: Bone Colossus Rune
rune_bone_colossus.lore: Five dead, bound as one, and it remembers being a wall.

rune_creeping_rot.name: Creeping Rot Rune
rune_creeping_rot.lore: Rot that has learned to walk.

rune_contagion.name: Contagion Rune
rune_contagion.lore: It does not stop at the grave.

rune_hollow_choir.name: Hollow Choir Rune
rune_hollow_choir.lore: The dead sing, and are not spent.

rune_requiem.name: Requiem Rune
rune_requiem.lore: A hymn is only terrible once it is finished.
